answer: Weight comes only from a chain of past graded work. A newcomer starts at zero and must pass 6 tasks across 6 successive epochs, one per epoch, no skipping. Each grade is checked twice: its jury scores it, then a second jury mirrors that scoring line by line, and any mismatch forces a re-grade of the chain. A failure, a copy, or a missed epoch restarts the chain at zero. Only after the sixth pass does the identity cross a glacier and enter haven, where its history finally counts. Running 100 fakes costs 600 graded tasks, each unshareable.
